idea-plugin.name: File Hider
idea-plugin.description:
Hides configured file and directory names from IntelliJ IDEA Project Tree without changing the filesystem, indexing, VCS, search, or build behavior.
根据全局规则在 IntelliJ IDEA 的 Project 视图中隐藏指定文件或目录，仅影响项目树展示； 不会删除文件，不会修改 .gitignore，也不会影响索引、编译、VCS、搜索或磁盘文件。
开源地址:https://github.com/itguang/FileHider
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial version with global rules, import/export, Project View filtering, and a per-project show-hidden toggle.

action.description: Temporarily show files hidden by File Hider in this project
